citations.narrative:
The facility did not maintain a complete medical record for all dogs. The facility states they treated a 4 year old adult
female Rottweiler (#3069) by giving fluids and a high protein food after the animal was found to be vomiting and having
bloody diarrhea. However, the facility did not record any of the treatments given in the medical record.
Failure to maintain adequate medical records may interfere with the ability of APHIS officials to determine if the animals
are receiving adequate veterinary care. Complete medical records must be maintained and include the names of all
vaccines and treatments administered and the dates of administration. Correct by documenting all treatments given and
ensure that medical records are complete and contain the required information. Correct by 14-JULY-2026.
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with the Licensee.

3.13(b)(3) 
   
Veterinary care for dogs. 
The facility did not maintain a complete medical record for all dogs. The facility states they treated a 4 year old adult 
female Rottweiler (#3069) by giving fluids and a high protein food after the animal was found to be vomiting and having 
bloody diarrhea. However, the facility did not record any of the treatments given in the medical record. 
 
Failure to maintain adequate medical records may interfere with the ability of APHIS officials to determine if the animals 
are receiving adequate veterinary care. Complete medical records must be maintained and include the names of all 
vaccines and treatments administered and the dates of administration. Correct by documenting all treatments given and 
ensure that medical records are complete and contain the required information. Correct by 14-JULY-2026. 
 
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with the Licensee.
